data.rationale: The proposal follows the same four-stage procedure (Wikipedia, then timeanddate, then a Notes entry) with the right parameters. It differs in small ways: it adds a time zone to the note, wrongly implies the capital is read from the article when it is a parameter, and uses a vaguer "click result" step. A browser automation could still be built from it.
